When the house finally gets quiet

A hush read for tired bodies and busy minds—pairs with Peace for Restless Nights.

Read-aloud

Sometimes bedtime comes and the day still feels loud inside—even when the rooms are still. God does not ask you to solve tomorrow before you sleep. He invites you to lay down in His peace.

I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety. Psalm 4:8 (KJV)

Little ones can hear this too: the Lord keeps watch while we rest. Grown-ups do not have to carry every worry into the dark alone.

Gentle question

What is one thing from today we can hand to God before we close our eyes?

Short prayer together

Lord, when the house gets quiet, help us lay down in peace. Keep us safe in You. Amen.

Coloring idea

A small lamp on a nightstand, soft blanket, moon through the window. Verse Image → Quiet porch (T17).
